items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Then we branched off and I got with Bill Phillips, Dix, his syncopators.

ctx.x: I just heard of Alfred Bill. You know?

Alfred, uh, Alfred plays saxophone with Skiz play bass. He's up around, out around Naptown, Indianapolis somewhere now. Final bass player too. Very nice. And, uh, well, I went on with them with the Preston City high-hats. And I stayed with them until, uh, oh, I guess we kept the band going until, uh, about two years or three years maybe. Then we branched off and I got with Bill Phillips, Dix, his syncopators. And from then on, well, I played with just practically every local band in this territory. Joe Robichaux,…
